verdict.rationale: Sierra is an agent-building platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents scoped API keys, permission scopes, or per-agent credential issuance. The MCP gateway blog only says it 'safely connects AI agents' to tools, which is an adjacent feature, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
